messages:
Maria Gonzales: Heads-up — GreenLane Logistics (enterprise, renewal in 10d) is at-risk. Usage down ~60% since Jan, onboarding flagged as incomplete, and they reported repeated inference timeouts. Need a short save plan.
Ajay Patel: Do we have root cause for the timeouts? infra or prompt/usage change?
Loren Chen: From logs it looks like a combination: KV cache misses + a spike in long-context requests. Also a couple of model fallbacks triggered yesterday. I'll paste the tail of the runtime error here.
onboard-bot: Incident digest for GreenLane: 3 model fallbacks in last 24h; median p95 latency 1.8s -> 3.6s. See /incidents/GL-1938
Ajay Patel: thx. If latencies doubled they'd hit their SLOs and reduce calls. Can we offer a temporary routing policy to dedicated capacity for their critical endpoints?
Kiran Rao: I can propose a short Dedicated trial for 4 weeks (discounted) as part of a save offer — but need ENG signoff on config and a clear rollback.
Sophie Bell: I'll own the success-gap audit and customer messaging. Plan: 1) triage call, 2) quick config changes (routing + cache warm), 3) targeted enablement sessions, 4) 4-week trial offer if needed. Draft script below.
Maria Gonzales: Need script + owner table. Also capture what downgrade path looks like if they insist on cost cut. We should preserve revenue but keep options.
Sophie Bell: Script (short):
```
Hi GreenLane team — thanks for the flag. We see increased long-context usage causing cache churn and fallback to slower model variants. Proposed immediate steps: (1) 30-min triage call with engineering, (2) enable prefix caching and route critical API to a reserved pool, (3) 2x enablement sessions on prompt engineering and token controls. If you'd like, we can activate a 4-week Dedicated trial while we optimize.
```
Loren Chen: Technical checklist I can run before the call:
- check KV hit rates for last 7 days
- dump model fallback logs
- identify top request signatures (seq len distribution)
- prepare a hot-cache preload for top prefixes
I'll post results in 2 hours.
Ajay Patel: Sales asks: what's the minimal discount/commit to keep them on hosted? If they push to downgrade to lower tier, propose a staggered downgrade (preserve critical endpoints on Dedicated) so we don't regress latency.
Kiran Rao: Proposed offer: 20% credit for 4 weeks + 2 enablement sessions + no-penalty cancellation after trial. If they want to downgrade seats only, provide an alternative: reduce non-critical routes to a low-cost variant, keep 1 route on guaranteed capacity.
Maria Gonzales: Good. Who will lead the call? Ajay can you take the AE side, Sophie will lead CS, Loren ENG, Kiran for commercial.
Ajay Patel: I can do 11am PT tomorrow. Sending meeting invite now.
Sophie Bell: I'll craft the slide 1-pager and a one-click checklist for the call. Target: share before EOD today.
Loren Chen: KV hit-rate: 12% -> that's the root; fallback logs show bursty long-context spikes around 9-10am PT daily. Preload script ready, will push if we get approval during call.
Maria Gonzales: Ok action items:
- Sophie: 1-pager + messaging (owner)
- Loren: triage logs + preload (owner)
- Ajay: run call + negotiation (owner)
- Kiran: draft trial commercial terms & downgrade path doc (owner)
Please update the doc and tag me when completed. If we don't have firm plan in 48h escalate to @VP_CS.
Kiran Rao: Drafted trial T&Cs and downgrade matrix, uploading to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/GL-save-proposal
Sophie Bell: Slide + script updated. Quick QA: can we offer a limited SLA during the trial? Ops: any objections?
onboard-bot: SLA addendum template available at /templates/temporary-sla.md
Loren Chen: Ops ok with temporary SLA for 4 weeks if we scope critical routes. No infra changes needed beyond routing policy.
Ajay Patel: Invite sent. GreenLane accepted 11am PT. I'll add the agenda: triage -> proposal -> next steps.
Maria Gonzales: Great. If call goes well, close win: convert trial to a 6-month reserved uplift. If they push to downgrade instead, follow downgrade matrix from Kiran and preserve 1 guaranteed route.
Sophie Bell: I'll capture feedback during call and instrument a short NPS + friction survey post-trial to monitor. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzales: Thank you everyone. Tag updates in this thread. :rotating_light: Deadline: plan & assets in 48h.
